meta.title: Carsea — Independent new-car research
meta.description: Carsea helps you research and compare new passenger cars in Indonesia before you buy, with no paid placement.

footer.label: More links
footer.tagline: Independent research for new cars in Indonesia.

home.heading: Choose a new car on reasons, not adverts.
home.lead: Carsea is independent research for new-car buyers in Indonesia. We explain why a car fits you, what you give up, and where every fact comes from.

browse.heading: Already know what you want?
browse.body: Skip the questions and filter by price, body style, and powertrain yourself.

facts.heading: Every fact carries its source stamp and date.
facts.body: A checked price does not mean every specification was checked. So Carsea records each fact in its own cell, and says plainly which are verified, which are estimates, which are old, and which we do not have.
facts.caption: An illustration of how Carsea records facts. This is not real vehicle data.

price.note: Source: official price list. Checked 12 Sep 2026.

service.note: Calculated from the official service schedule and your distance.

insurance.label: Insurance per month
insurance.note: We do not fill in a figure we cannot support with a source.

points.title: No paid placement
points.body: No sponsors, no manufacturer adverts, and no ranking that can be bought.

points.title: No selling your contact
points.body: Carsea does not ask for your name or phone number and does not pass you to a dealer.

points.title: Rules you can read
points.body: Recommendations are ordered by written rules applied to your answers, not a hidden score.
